subject.title: fix: gateway boot recovers from a dead-owner migration lease and names its breaker escape hatch

question: Should this availability-sensitive startup recovery change merge after the contributor supplies real killed-owner or breaker-recovery evidence on the rebased head?
rationale: The patch changes the gateway boot decision that governs access to startup migrations, while the required live proof remains absent and the PR carries the protected `maintainer` label.

options.title: Require live recovery proof
options.body: Keep the narrow implementation and request a redacted terminal or log transcript from a killed-owner restart or real breaker recovery before merging.

options.title: Accept test-only evidence
options.body: Merge based on the focused regression suite while explicitly accepting that the reported operational scenario was not demonstrated after the fix.

recommendation.title: Require live recovery proof
recommendation.body: Keep the narrow implementation and request a redacted terminal or log transcript from a killed-owner restart or real breaker recovery before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied history shows direct ownership of the proposed gateway lifecycle changes and associated regression coverage.
